findings.description: Valid age submit fails in real web app at encrypted key creation: randomBytes export is not a function. Baseline reaches consent URL but independently fails into paused health shell. Complete both boundaries without weakening privacy or treating Node tests as Metro proof.

AgePolicyGate admits only welcome/age without receipt and its unavailable UI only offers retry; existing account/data-rights shell is nested inside that gate. Legacy16+ re-verification needs safe rights access without health processing or broad protected route mounting.
Integrated owner switch/sign-out/guest upgrade, withdrawal/deletion pending/retry/non-resurrection, and manual Shelf offline/CRUD/corruption matrix remains unfinished.

M1 report profile regressed previously established evidence requirements: accepts empty evidence with PASS, tests newer than declared measurement, and unmeasured source drift. Extend real-CLI tests; preserve M0 guards.
Derived Phase4 worklist fingerprints stale after Shelf source changes. Narrow generator-only refresh of two derived files authorized, without changing any gate/policy/owner acceptance.
